name: pharmacogenomics-guidelines-mcp-server
description: Find pharmacogenomics guidelines, translate diplotypes, and retrieve prescribing recommendations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Find pharmacogenomics guidelines, translate diplotypes, and retrieve prescribing recommendations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Query the public CPIC Database through six read-only tools: discover evaluated gene–drug pairs, retrieve guidelines, translate source-supported diplotypes, browse or match prescribing recommendations, inspect allele evidence, and list reference values. Results preserve source records, guideline links and provenance. Matching requires every source genetic prerequisite; omitted genes are never assumed normal or negative. No API key is required.
